page.overview:
Who is Neo Shadaloo?

All three factions of Neo Shadaloo appear in the World Tour mode of Street Fighter 6. Ed appears on his own, with his group having separated for the time being in order to lay low, as a different faction of Neo Shadaloo is in the process of tracking them down with the goal of instating Ed as Bison's replacement and using the power of the other members for their own means. The Bison loyalist faction of Neo Shadaloo is shown operating out of a destroyed Shadaloo base, conducting numerous experiments with Psycho Power. F.A.N.G is shown to be in regular contact with this group, and works with them to track down former Shadaloo operatives in order to rebuild the organization, though he is shown to be in conflict with JP, who heads the initiative seeking to make Ed the leader.

After his resurrection, an amnesiac M. Bison arrives at the laboratory, with the group working to regain his memories and restore both him and Shadaloo to its former glory. Vega and Balrog have also shown interest in joining with the revived Shadaloo, though the latter expresses he may consider siding with Ed's Neo Shadaloo as opposed to the M. Bison loyalist faction.

The name Neo Shadaloo first appears in reference to the faction formed by Ed and Falke during the events of Street Fighter V following Shadaloo's fall. The organization's goals and intents and their ties to the fallen Shadaloo are, according to Falke's character story, to find and help those who were victims of Shadaloo's experiments, and it has been stressed repeatedly in storylines that both Ed and Falke utterly hated Shadaloo due to both being former replacement vessels for M. Bison. As such, the group is considered to be very much against the original Shadaloo and benign in motivation.

In Street Fighter 6 however, Neo Shadaloo hired Juri to capture Bosch and recover the funds he stole to stop the Suval'hal tournament. As a result, they used Bosch for Psycho Power-related experiments so that he would represent the organization in the tournament. It's unknown what are the organization's goals and intents for this, some even speculate that they simply want to bring back Shadaloo, a goal entirely contradictory to Ed and Falke's original stated intentions. However, this appears to be the work of a web of contacts maintained by F.A.N.G; furthermore, they are unaware that JP knew their movements and manipulated their actions into unknowingly helping him reviving Shadaloo's legacy with a new face, much to F.A.N.G's dismay. F.A.N.G and his contacts move forward with plans to both covertly investigate and hinder JP's operation, and later, when M. Bison resurfaces following an imperfect rebirth, to attempt to restore Bison's memories and reinstall the original dictator as the head of Shadaloo. To this end, F.A.N.G sends out his apprentice A.K.I. and manipulates the Avatar while operating under aliases such as "Fang Fei" and "Foo". In A.K.I.'s arcade, she encounters JP and corners him in battle, having him dead to rights before choosing to let him go since her master instructed her not to use lethal force.
